title.rendered: Ajanta Bottle has strong foothold in the glass packaging industry: Walter Dsouza, Ex-Piramal Glass

content.rendered:
Valuable Associate Feedback: Mr. Walter Dsouza

Thank you so much, Mr. Walter Dsouza,
Marketing, Ex-Piramal Glass, and Vitrum Glass for taking out time to provide us with your valuable feedback for Ajanta Bottle Pvt. Ltd.

We are truly humbled by your words of appreciation and blessings for Ajanta Bottle.

Thank you for guiding and supporting Ajanta Bottle, especially in its initial years.

We will always cherish the memories created in our long association of 40 years.

Wishing all the very best to you, D’Souza Sir always.

To see Ajanta Bottle’s wide collection of a glass bottles and glass jars and purchase online, visit https://zcu.io/Xvxt.
